titel: Biscuit dough crumbles when rolled out
kurz: The dough is too cold, too dry or not pressed together enough: the butter does not hold [[krume|the crumbs]] together.
bild_im_kopf: Like a snowball made of powder snow: too cold and too dry, it will not hold.

ursachen.titel: Too cold straight from the fridge
ursachen.warum: Very cold butter is brittle and breaks rather than giving.
fix: Leave at room temperature for 10 minutes
Work it briefly with your hands

ursachen.warum: Without enough egg or water, flour and fat do not bind into a dough.
fix: Work in a tablespoon of cold water or egg white

ursachen.warum: Shortcrust should barely be kneaded, but it must be pressed firmly together once.
fix: Press into a ball, chill flat in film

q1.frage: Did the dough come straight from the fridge?

q2.frage: Is it dry and crumbly even after warming up?
